title: my job hunt - cover email draft (--output-schema)
description: Passed to `codex exec --output-schema` for the cover email. Same strict-mode rules as score_batch: every property required, additionalProperties false, nullable via type arrays.

subject.description: Application: <exact role title> - <candidate name>. One line, no newlines.

body.description: The whole email text without the subject line, starting with the greeting and ending with the sign-off and contact block. 120-180 words in English.

language.description: en unless the posting is written mainly in Thai.

facts_used.description: The facts.md IDs the draft relies on, e.g. ["F23", "F21"].
